pages.title: Special Species
pages.text: These bees are the pinnacle of breeding or are obtained through unique means. They possess powerful traits and produce valuable resources.

$(li)Emerald Bee: Produces Emeralds.$(br)$(o)Blocks: Emerald Ore, Deepslate Emerald Ore, Emerald Block.$()$(br)$(li)Diamond Bee: Produces Diamonds.$(br)$(o)Blocks: Diamond Ore, Deepslate Diamond Ore, Diamond Block.$()$(br)$(li)Obsidian Bee: Produces Obsidian.$(br)$(o)Blocks: Obsidian, Crying Obsidian.$()$(br)$(li)Amethyst Bee: Produces Amethyst Shards.$(br)$(o)Block: Amethyst Block.$()$(br)$(li)Ancient Debris Bee: Produces Netherite Scrap.$(br)$(o)Blocks: Ancient Debris, Netherite Block.$()

pages.title: Utility & Worker Bees
pages.text: $(li)Farming Bee: Harvests crops.$(br)$(o)Block: Farmland.$()$(br)$(li)Ice Bee: Produces Ice.$(br)$(o)Blocks: Snow Block, Ice, Packed Ice.$()$(br)$(li)Breeze Bee: Produces Breeze Rods.$(br)$(o)Blocks: Tuff, Chiseled Tuff.$()$(br)$(li)Light Bee: Produces Torches.$(br)$(o)Blocks: Glowstone, Redstone Lamp, Froglights.$()$(br2)The other worker bees (Mining, Lumber, Fighting) do not require specific blocks to function, only a valid task in their work area.
